title: Hardware and Firmware Verification for Supply Chain Assurance
summary: Learn how Palitronica helps detect supplier changes and potential tampering through hardware and firmware verification across the electronics supply chain.
body_markdown:
###


Verify the Electronics You Receive


An unchanged part number does not guarantee unchanged electronics. Suppliers may substitute components or revise board layouts without notice, and devices can be swapped or modified during transport. These changes can introduce quality, interoperability, and cybersecurity risks without leaving an obvious visual trace.


With Palitronica's Anvil platform compare received units against an approved reference or golden sample. Teams can monitor consistency across shipments and production runs, including products that remain in service through years of supplier and component changes.


Palitronica supports these checkpoints with measurable, repeatable testing and traceable logs that can inform supplier scorecards and support audit reporting.

###


Build Evidence Across the Electronics Supply Chain


For automotive, aerospace, defence, and critical infrastructure organizations, verification at receiving docks and before final assembly provides an opportunity to identify problems before electronics enter critical systems.


Download the “Supply Chain Assurance” brochure to learn how independent hardware and firmware verification can strengthen quality and cyber integrity across your electronics supply chain.
